business_type: mature compounder (monopoly equipment supplier with cyclical order flow)
moat_source: literal monopoly in EUV lithography with decades of accumulated optics/supply-chain IP; evidence: 53% gross margin on EUR 8.8B quarterly sales, EUR 38.8B backlog, customers (TSMC/Intel/Samsung) with no alternative supplier

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3. Excludes dividend/buybacks (~1%/yr).

sensitivity_key_driver: terminal multiple (what the market pays for monopoly earnings in 2031)
primary_model_risk: Multiple regime: the stock re-rated from its historical ~30x to ~57x annualized earnings in twelve months. Base case terminal multiple (30x) assumes reversion to the historical regime; if the market permanently pays 40x+ for the EUV monopoly (bull logic), today's price is defensible - the model's biggest input is a market-psychology variable, not an operating one.
expectations_gap_key_variable: the multiple, not the business: at $1,855 (~57x annualized EPS for ~13% growth) the price embeds either a permanent multiple re-rating or a growth acceleration the EUR 36-40B guide does not support; our base case honors the monopoly with a 30x terminal and still lands 40% below the quote
top_5_bull_arguments: The only EUV supplier on Earth: competitive risk is rated Low - unique on this watchlist
EUR 38.8B backlog plus record EUR 13.2B quarterly bookings give multi-year revenue insurance
FY2026 guidance already raised (EUR 36-40B) on TSMC/Intel/Samsung fab acceleration
53% gross margin at the top of guidance shows pricing power intact
High-NA EUV is an uncontested second act: every leading-edge roadmap through the 2030s requires ASML
top_5_bear_arguments: ~57x annualized earnings for 13% growth - roughly double the historical multiple after a +121% year; the re-rating is the entire bear case
Expected IV ($1,172.50) is ~37% below the price; even our bull case ($1,833) fails to reach today's quote
US China-export legislation could sever the remaining China channel (regulatory risk High)
Bookings disclosure pulled exactly when the order cycle is most scrutinized - July 15 is now a binary transparency event
Semicap orders are cyclical even for monopolies: 2027 delivery-target doubts and slow immersion sales are early wobbles
thesis_breakers: July 15 bookings materially below the EUR 13.2B Q4-2025 record run-rate (normalization confirmed)
FY2026 guidance cut back below EUR 36B
US legislation enacted severing China DUV sales
Gross margin below 50% for two consecutive quarters
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price; this is the highest-quality business on the watchlist at the wrong price - accumulation zone begins near expected IV (~$1,170)
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Revenue/EPS/backlog/bookings all reported (ASML releases) - strong data foundation; FCF path approximates net income (ASML's customer-prepayment model historically supports this) - confidence_level medium. EUR figures converted implicitly via the USD market snapshot; mixed-currency precision noted.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +121% over 12 months, -5.05% past week, trailing P/E 63.14 (pass1); historical-multiple comparison ('roughly double') is inferred from the trailing P/E vs the low-30s implied by FY2025 EPS at early-2025 prices - directional, not precise.
